verdict.rationale: Supabase documents three first-party ways to test away from production. Branching creates separate environments and per-PR preview environments "without affecting your production setup." The CLI runs the entire stack locally or in CI. The MCP server is served locally at localhost:54321/mcp and also exposes branch create, merge, reset and rebase tools, so an AI agent can work against a sandbox; community commenters also point to dev/staging-only use as the intended pattern. One hands-on report says local development was hard to get working (Val Town), while another found it easy, which tempers rather than contradicts the claim. missing for 10: MCP branching tools are labeled experimental, no independent hands-on corroboration of branching, mixed hands-on reports on local-dev reliability, and no evidence on seeding sandbox data.
